text: CI runs the gate's own integration tests and the opt-in real suites on pushes to main as well as pull requests (#436). Branches needn't be up to date to merge (strict: false), so two pull requests that passed apart could break main together unseen, as D-0091 recorded for #62. .github/real-suites.sh now covers every package of the module the real suites' tests import, internal/tlc, internal/gobra, internal/decisions, internal/mcp and four factory cores among them. A test reads Go's import graph and fails on any package no rule covers. A doc never starts a suite, a real suite runs only when the gate does, and cmd/invariant starts only the Python suite, since the TLAPS tests don't import it. Each test shard's log ends with its 20 slowest tests, from go test's JSON, after internal/verify's tests had grown unseen to 92–97% of their timeout. The health review on 2026-11-02 found these gaps.
